{{Version|2.2.23}}
[[File:Pets Button.png|frameless|left]]
Pets can be unlocked after beating Obelisk 17. The pets are unlocked using gems, but after the 1st pet they require a combined total of pet levels before the next can be purchased. The initial max level of Pet is 10, but this limit can be raised up to 25 depending on pet, through [[Stargazing]], [[Construct#Statues|Statues]], Pet Skin, [[Challenges]] and [[Archaeology]].

{{clear|left}}
==Strategy==
Each pet needs a higher Total Pet Level to unlock. It's good to buy them as soon as they are available so they'll have more chances to level up. The only time you shouldn't buy them immediately is if you won't be able to level them up. Like buying Duck before you unlock veins, or Axolotl before you are in World 2.

When you unlock pets, you will find beating Obelisks becomes more difficult. That means it's time to work on content you have already unlocked, like [[Prestige]], [[Challenges]] and the Dwarf Pet.

==Pet Skins==
Pets skins are an alternate skin for your pet. They reduce the level up requirement of the pet from 15% to 30%, as well as an additional bonus. They become available after the pet gets to level 5. The first pet skin costs 1000 gems, the cost increases by 100 per pet (except for Dino, Mr. Nibbles, Nagini, Butterfly, and Rhino skins which have different prices). Pet skins '''<u>do not</u>''' have to be equipped for the bonus to be applied. When a pet is level 10 its Quest Skin becomes available. Unlocking the Quest Skin costs 1500 gems for the first one and increases by 500 per pet. Purchasing the Quest Skin provides the equivalent of one level of that Pet's quest.

==Pet Quests==
Pet Quests are an extra challenge for Pets. They can be unlocked by purchasing the respective Pet Skin in the Skins submenu once the pet has reached level 10. Ranks are capped at 10 by default, but the Rank cap can be increased via the [[Fishing#tabber-Melting Gibbous|Melting Gibbous Tier 2 Tribute]].

== Level Caps ==
There are several ways to increase pet level caps. The first that most players encounter is [[Stargazing#Stars|Pisces]], which increases the cap for all pets by 1 per level, up to a maximum of +4. Many cap increases are applied to all pets for a total of 20. Any increases above 20 are applied to specific pets instead.

==Trivia==
* It takes about 1,225,650 [[Bombs#tabber-Gem_Bomb|Gem Bombs]] fired for the Whale Pet Quest to pay itself back which would occur a little after rank 4. This takes into account the Ranks it gains along the way but does not take into account free bomb chance. The total number of bombs recharged would be around 25% lower but will depend on the free bomb chance at the time of firing.
